content: चेष्ट् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (चेष्टते, चेष्टित) .²1 To move about, stir, be active, show signs of life; यदा स देवो जागर्ति तदेदं चेष्टते जगत् <ls>Ms. 1. 52</ls>; <ls>Māl. 8. 8</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 27</ls>. .²2 To make effort, endeavour, exert oneself, struggle. .²3 To perform, do (anything). .²4 To frequent. .²5 To behave, act. With वि .²1 to stir, move, be in motion, move about. .²2 to act, behave.
